highlights: End-to-End Audio Production: Master podcast planning, multitrack recording, Audacity editing, mixing, and final distribution.
Acoustic Foundations & Mic Technique: Learn microphone polar patterns, gain staging, pop filters, and room treatment.
Hands-On Dialogue Editing in Audacity: Remove unwanted pauses, filler words, plosives, and mouth clicks while preserving natural conversation flow.
Speech Cleanup & Frequency Balance: Apply non-destructive noise reduction, parametric EQ, vocal compression, and gentle de-essing.
Loudness Consistency & Industry Standards: Understand integrated LUFS, true-peak measurement, and platform normalization policies.
Structured Interview Workflows: Design compelling interview guides, conduct pre-interview briefings, and capture double-ender remote recordings.
Introductory Video Podcasting: Frame solo and two-person setups, synchronize separate audio and video tracks, and export broadcast-ready clips.
Modern Spotify for Creators 2027 Workflow: Navigate current hosting management, finished file ingestion, episode metadata, and analytics.
RSS Feed Architecture & Email Privacy: Understand XML feed structures, directory aggregation, and protecting private contact emails.
YouTube Podcasts & India RSS Ingestion: Organize podcast playlists, video episodes, and utilize YouTube RSS ingestion for static-image video generation.
Directory Submission Protocols: Prepare compliant submissions for Apple Podcasts Connect, Spotify, and major listening directories.
10-Component Capstone Portfolio: Deliver a complete show bible, trailer, full 12–20min episode, video sample, artwork, and client handover package.

production_standards.heading: Audacity Spoken-Word Audio Quality Standard
production_standards.core_rule: Noise reduction cannot repair bad acoustic environments. Speech quality must be captured cleanly at the microphone.
production_standards.lufs_policy: Teach commonly used podcast loudness conventions (-16 LUFS for stereo, -19 LUFS for mono) without falsely prescribing a single mandatory universal standard.

ethical_standards.heading: Record With Permission. Edit Without Distorting Meaning.
core_principles: Explicit guest consent required prior to recording and publication.
Conversational integrity: never rearrange dialogue to misrepresent speaker intentions.
Strict copyright clearance: only use licensed music or royalty-free audio assets.

spotify_for_creators.discontinued_tools: Native built-in recording, episode builder editing, Record with Friends, and Music+Talk were discontinued.
spotify_for_creators.correct_workflow: External audio production in Audacity, followed by finished file upload and RSS distribution management.
spotify_for_creators.riverside_integration: Riverside is an external third-party partner integration with separate terms, not a native Spotify feature.
spotify_for_creators.external_directories: Spotify hosting does not automatically syndicate to Apple Podcasts; separate Apple Podcasts Connect submission is required.

rss_privacy.notice: Enabling external Spotify RSS feed distribution may expose the account email address publicly in the RSS XML feed.
rss_privacy.safeguard: Students are taught to create dedicated, professional show email addresses rather than exposing personal inboxes.

youtube_podcasts.platform_model: Podcast = Designated Playlist; Episode = Video in that playlist.
youtube_podcasts.india_eligibility: India is fully eligible for YouTube RSS podcast ingestion under current regional platform documentation.
youtube_podcasts.workflows: Workflow A (Native video podcast upload) and Workflow B (Audio-first RSS ingestion generating static-image videos).

publishing_policy.description: Public publishing is strictly optional. A complete staged/private distribution package receives full grading and portfolio credit.

faq.question: What is Podcast Production & Distribution?
faq.answer: It is a practical course teaching podcast concept development, recording, editing, interview production, audio packaging and distribution workflows.

faq.question: How long is the course?
faq.answer: Six weeks, totaling 48 learning hours.

faq.question: What is the course fee?
faq.answer: ₹7,900, subject to Nova Skills' verified pricing and tax policy.

faq.question: Is the course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. Basic computer literacy and willingness to record original audio are sufficient.

faq.question: What is the primary audio editing software?
faq.answer: Audacity.

faq.question: Is Audacity free?
faq.answer: Yes. Audacity is available as free, open-source audio software.

faq.question: Do I need an expensive microphone?
faq.answer: No. The course teaches practical recording with suitable equipment and proper microphone technique.

faq.question: Will the institute provide microphones?
faq.answer: The proposed curriculum includes institute-managed equipment during supervised labs. Availability must be verified for the actual delivery arrangement.

faq.question: Will I learn microphone placement?
faq.answer: Yes. Mic positioning, room acoustics, gain staging and recording checks are included.

faq.question: Will I learn noise reduction?
faq.answer: Yes. Students practise Audacity cleanup while learning that excessive noise reduction can damage audio quality.

faq.question: Will I learn EQ and compression?
faq.answer: Yes. The editing module covers both at a beginner applied level.

faq.question: What is LUFS?
faq.answer: LUFS is a measure used to assess perceived audio loudness and help maintain suitable listening consistency.

faq.question: Will I learn podcast interviewing?
faq.answer: Yes. Question design, listening, remote recording and guest preparation are included.

faq.question: Will I learn video podcast production?
faq.answer: Yes, at an introductory level covering framing, audio-video synchronization and basic editing.

faq.question: Will I learn DaVinci Resolve?
faq.answer: It may be used for the introductory video-podcast workflow, not as a complete DaVinci Resolve certification.

faq.question: Will I use Riverside or Descript?
faq.answer: These are optional supporting tools when appropriately available and licensed.

faq.question: Does Spotify for Creators still offer built-in recording and editing?
faq.answer: Its former native recording and editing tools were discontinued. The course uses separate production software.

faq.question: What is Spotify for Creators used for?
faq.answer: Podcast hosting, uploading finished episodes, show management, distribution settings and available analytics.

faq.question: What is a podcast RSS feed?
faq.answer: It is a structured feed containing podcast and episode information used by compatible podcast directories and applications.

faq.question: Does Spotify automatically distribute to Apple Podcasts?
faq.answer: No. External directory submission generally requires separate action.

faq.question: Can the email address in an RSS feed become public?
faq.answer: Yes. Enabling a Spotify-hosted RSS feed can expose its associated email address.

faq.question: Will I learn Apple Podcasts submission?
faq.answer: Yes. The course includes Apple Podcasts Connect, RSS requirements, validation and approval awareness.

faq.question: Will I learn YouTube Podcasts?
faq.answer: Yes. The course explains podcast playlists, video episodes and supported RSS ingestion.

faq.question: Is YouTube RSS podcast ingestion supported in India?
faq.answer: Yes, under YouTube's current eligible-region guidance, subject to channel eligibility.

faq.question: Must I publish my podcast publicly?
faq.answer: No. An approved private or staged distribution package satisfies the assessment.

faq.question: What will I create during the course?
faq.answer: A show bible, trailer, full audio episode, short video exercise, artwork, metadata, QA checklist and distribution package.

faq.question: How long is the final audio episode?
faq.answer: Twelve to twenty minutes.

faq.question: How long is the trailer?
faq.answer: Sixty to ninety seconds.

faq.question: Will I learn podcast monetization?
faq.answer: The course introduces distribution and basic analytics, but complete monetization strategy is outside its scope.

faq.question: Who should enroll?
faq.answer: Aspiring podcasters, creators, interviewers, educators, marketers and professionals interested in branded audio/video conversations. ---
